title: Data Scientist-Artificial Intelligence Intern
job_description: Introduction A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You’ll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you’ll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You’ll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences. Your Role And Responsibilities We are focused on developing and implementing advanced,Large Language Models (LLMs) and agentic workflows to solve real-world complex problem.Gain hands-on experience with state-of-the-art AI technologies while contributing to meaningful projects that push the boundaries of what's possible with generative AI.Develop and test multimodal AI solutions combining text, image, and other data modalities.Design and build autonomous AI agents capable of multi-step reasoning and task completion Create tool-using agents that can interact with APIs, databases, and external systems. Develop workflow orchestration systems for complex, multi-agent collaborations Required Technical And Professional Expertise Programming: Strong proficiency in Python. ML/DL Frameworks: Experience with PyTorch or TensorFlow. GenAI Stack: Familiarity with LangChain, Hugging Face, or OpenAI API. Data Libraries: Strong knowledge of Pandas, NumPy, and scikit-learn. Database: Working knowledge of SQL.
